en.title: Agent playtest, project repair and QR preview
en.body: Check the first meaningful action and restart in verify-game, apply a scoped project transaction to a failed revision and preview the same passing build by QR on a phone.

zh.title: 智能体试玩、工程修复与扫码预览
zh.body: 通过 verify-game 核对首次有效操作与重开，用有范围约束的事务修复失败修订，并在手机上扫码试玩通过检查的同一构建。
